```{python}
#| label: GreedyconvergenceSVK
#| fig-cap: "Loss convergence"
# 
import plotly.graph_objects as go
import pandas as pd

# Load the CSV data
# Loss_gap = (loss - L_ref) / |L_ref|, with L_ref = -52.20 slightly below the lowest loss reached by any run
try:
    data = pd.read_csv("SVK_lung_6D_greedy.csv")
except:
    data = pd.read_csv("Figures/SVK_lung_6D_greedy.csv")
# Extract data
epochs = data['epochs']
gap = data['Loss_gap']
modes = data['Modes']

# Create the figure
fig = go.Figure()

# Add Loss gap trace
fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
    x=epochs, y=gap,
    name='Loss gap',
    yaxis='y1',
    mode='lines',
    line=dict(color='#170f38')
))

# Add Modes trace
fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
    x=epochs, y=modes,
    visible='legendonly',
    name='Modes',
    yaxis='y2',
    mode='lines',
    line=dict(color='#3a46f5', shape='hv')
))

# Update layout
fig.update_layout(
    plot_bgcolor='rgba(0,0,0,0)',  # Remove background color
    width=560, 
    height=400,  
    xaxis=dict(title='Iterations (L-BFGS)',
        showgrid=True,
        gridcolor='lightgray'),
    yaxis=dict(
        title=dict(
            text='Relative loss gap', 
            font=dict(color='#170f38')),
        type='log',
        tickvals=[1e-3, 1e-2, 1e-1, 1],
        ticktext=['10⁻³', '10⁻²', '10⁻¹', '1'],
        tickfont=dict(color='#170f38'),
        showgrid=True,
        gridcolor='lightgray'
    ),
    yaxis2=dict(
        title=dict(
            text='Modes', 
            font=dict(color='#3a46f5')),
        overlaying='y',
        side='right',
        range=[0, 15],
        tickvals=[1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14],
        tickfont=dict(color='#3a46f5')
        
    ),
    legend=dict(x=1.12, y=0.9)
    
)

# Show the figure
fig.show()

```
